author: Zintenka
body:
Looks cool, doesn't it?

Anyway, took a long break from map making because my topics these days turn into heated arguments.

But I dont care anymore. And I made sure that I put heavy debuffs to chase away ppl thinking that the item is still OP *Glares suspiciously*

And there is TNT; deal with it I:(


Features:
  • A kill gives you 4 xp bottles
  • TNT
  • Ship based combat as well as traditional ground warfare
  • 4 monuments
  • 50vs50
  • You have to mine for iron ore. But you get coal by mining coal blocks. (Coal block can smelt a lot of iron ores)
  • Lapiz lazuli found in the island. (In preparation for 1.8's new enchanting system)
  • Diamond ore found in the island and on the ships and center.
  • Spawners in the center send down potion particles which give you strength, night vision and etc. for 30 seconds.
YML

Imgur

Download

The ships themselves have TNT supplies, wood supplies, redstone supplies, and food supplies.

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
I like it but

Have Leather or more Iron
Because of the diamond in the middle, if you get to it, it will be very uneven for the people that don't have the diamonds and where the iron is it seems like there is more diamond then iron.
If leather was there it would nice to have a 1-3 level tiers so you got something to fall back on later in the game

Potions in the Middle
The potions have strength and regen. Plus the diamonds in the middle makes it kill farmer heaven and it is a little opped. It is a little less then a golden apple op to tell you the truth. I would suggest remove one and if it was up to me it would be the strength because you can kill someone with a diamond sword and strength 1.5 hits. 

Spawns
Have a way to identify the redstone chests and the tnt chests because it is confusing for new players and if people have the memerizing skill of me and my main pvp team(We are a bunch of idiots though) and it would be nice to have a sign saying here is the tnt or here is the redstone
Enchanting
Enchanting is a harder thing to put into games then people think, and with 1.8 coming out, just so the map doesn't break there is a way to get lapiz right?
But back to what I want to say about why it is hard to have enchanting in a map. If I recall the map Titans, it is the most uneven gameplay map I have ever seen. It was all based on luck. I have checked out the map and it seems pretty good but make sure there is no bookcases near the enchanting tables so it doesn't turn into luck pvp. Also can you have enchanting tables closer to front lines so it doesn't take 5 hours to run around the map enchanting

The spawn location
It takes an unneeded amount of time to run to front lines from spawn because it is a little too back and you have to twist and turn a bit to get to front lines that people will get mad when they run 2.5 minutes or even a minute to get to front lines and get shot off in 2 seconds from bridging

The ships on the sides
I would suggest you lower them a bit because you do want people to go to the sides a bit more and it seems a little "Out of reach" to climb there. This is really a personal thing if you wanted the gameplay more spread out but it is all of a matter on how you wanted the map to turn out

The defenses
All defenses are spread out and the 2 that I think that are ok are the front one and the back left one
The cave one: It has lava in it and it seems a little open. With the tnt factor it is going to be so easy to blow your surrounding up and it could stalemate the map. Plus the evil lava factor where you have 13 sources to mess around with.
The mountain one: I would suggest moving or removing that one, If you would to move it you would move it closer to the big tree where it is flatter so the rusher would have less of a hassle to rush up a mountain. Also put bedrock under the monument so the tnt can't make a fully oped defense that can stalemate the game. If the new location looks a little to close to the cave then remove it or keep it in the same place.

You do not have to follow any of this it is just suggestions for you map
EDIT: I missed your lapiz thing and your island thing...READ PIE, READ!!!!

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
You can find diamond ore all over the island. So its not gonna be a killfarm.

The diamonds at the center are just an easier way of getting them. Besides, TNT will just obliterate the diamond ppl.

About the defenses, yeah i do that too. Its tactics. Many rushers can counter the cave's openness by tunneling above and hiding themselves. 

This map is about adding many gameplay options. TNT for defenses, lava to make a lava moat, lava to place ahead of a running enemy, TNT to counter cannons or blow up the enemy, etc. 

Many maps on Avicus dont have this variety. This is standard Avicus map policy from what i've seen and played: Rush towards monument, fight with swords, shoot with bows.

And that's pretty much it...

I want to add variety with enchanting, TNT, and ships. Totally new gameplay options.

I want the ships to remain where they are. If i moved them around, they'd delete some blocks with MC Edit's region selection. They are big. 

I dont really have to place signs. Its up to the player to find where the TNT chests are. (Pretty easy since theyre in spawn :/) 

And players do spawn with leather, in fact. They spawn with gold as well. 

No defense is fully OP, even my defenses.
